# THE NIGHT COUNT — Animation Asset Manifest

All character animation is **downloaded**, not authored. The source is one CC0 library, which keeps every figure in the game on a single skeleton and removes any retargeting error between characters.

**Pack:** Quaternius — *Universal Animation Library* (Standard, free tier)  
**Creator:** Quaternius  
**Licence:** CC0 1.0 — commercial use permitted, no attribution required (given anyway)  
**Official page:** https://quaternius.com/packs/universalanimationlibrary.html  
**File obtained from:** https://github.com/J-Ponzo/gltf-universal-animation-library — a CC0 redistribution in glTF form that names Quaternius as the author and includes the licence text  
**Rig:** Rigify-derived `DEF-*` skeleton, shared by mesh and all clips (no retargeting needed)  
**Root motion:** stripped at load; the game drives positions itself

## Environmental animation (not character animation)

Doors, the cash drawer, the roller shutter, the ceiling fan, the sign, vehicle
arrivals and the security cameras are animated procedurally in code from their
own state (`Station.updateDoors`, `systems/*`). These are mechanisms with one
degree of freedom, not performances; no animation pack was needed and none was
searched for beyond confirming that the door and drawer motions were trivial.

## Searches run before settling on this pack

| Looked for | Where | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| dressed, rigged, animated 1990s civilians | Sketchfab (CC0 filter) | downloads require an authenticated account; nothing usable without one |
| CC0 animated humans | Kenney | available (blocky/toy proportions) — rejected on art-direction grounds |
| Mixamo | adobe.com | requires an Adobe sign-in; not usable in this environment |
| Quaternius Universal **Base Characters** (dressed bodies) | itch.io | the download endpoint could not be completed non-interactively; the animation library's own mannequin mesh was used instead and dressed by vertex colouring |
